plain_english: Whatever I have truly done, O Lord — no duty of mine goes beyond this: my pride, laid at Your lotus feet with devotion. This is my all; I know there is nothing other. So, casting all else aside — quickly, O protector of the helpless, O ocean of compassion — be pleased with me!
sanskrit_cite: yatsatyaṃ tu mayā kṛtaṃ mama vibho kṛtyaṃ tu nātaḥ paraṃ yanmanmānamaiśapādakamale bhaktyā mayaivārpitam | sarvasvamata evametaditarannāsyeva jānāmyatastyaktvā kṣipramanāthanātha karuṇāsindho prasanno bhava
